question: Who should be worshipped even when participants are seated in śrāddha rites?
premises: Participants may already be seated in śrāddha rites.
The desire-granting one is still to be worshipped.
inference: Even during seated śrāddha rites, one should worship the desire-granting one.
uncertainties: The identity of the desire-granting one is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Even when people are seated in śrāddha rites, one should worship the desire-granting one.
